headline: GAP-175's documented scenario is fixed, and GAP-176/177/178 are fixed as specified. But fix-1 introduced a new BLOCKER in the destructive path (GAP-183: the PPID walk has no creation-time guard, and GC killed an unrelated process live), plus two more live-reproduced ways to kill or delete things it shouldn't (GAP-184, GAP-185).

priorGaps.GAP-175: documented scenario FIXED (own harness: two simultaneous custom state dirs, relaunch orphan, 8 concurrent GCs during an in-flight launch, all protected and usable). A live session is NOT always protected: GAP-185 (unreadable/mid-write state -> live Chrome killed, reproduced live 1/348) and GAP-184 (marker trust).
priorGaps.GAP-176: FIXED for the dir-reclaim goal (Done-when counts reach 0 in 3 independent runs), but the PPID walk that fixed it introduced GAP-183 over-kill
priorGaps.GAP-177: FIXED (own mutation M3 caught; own harness has no stale-session delete of live dirs)
priorGaps.GAP-178: FIXED (probeLock self-rename verified live against headless and headed Chrome: in-use while live, no mutation, free after kill; D2 and grace ordering mutations M4/M8 caught). A reverted destructive unlink is NOT caught by any test (M7).

newGaps: GAP-183 BLOCKER: killedTreePids PPID walk lacks spec 0.2's 'parent created before child' guard; live-reproduced GC killing an unrelated process (ppid-reuse/); worst-case real-table exposure is 211 processes incl. explorer (explorer-exposure.txt)

GAP-184 major: discoverMarkerStateFiles trusts a marker on ANY process, pointing at ANY path; live-reproduced deleting a non-Sutradhar file outside all roots + its parent dir + a 1-3s-old profile dir (adv-forged-marker.json)
GAP-185 major: unreadable/mid-write marker state file -> live Chrome killed + profile deleted; live race 1/348 (midwrite-race-strict output), deterministic 3/3 (main/adv-corrupt-state.json)
GAP-186 minor: GAP-175 wiring (M9) and the probeLock non-destructive swap (M7) have no regression tests; fix-1 saved no revert-and-confirm evidence despite claiming it
GAP-187 minor/observation: concurrent CLI commands on one session repeatedly self-heal a reachable session and leak Chromes (midwrite-race-diag300s.json); pre-existence not verified

verification.build: forced scoped build of cli/mcp-server/sdk + deps and sutradhar bundle: OK. A full forced turbo build fails only in @sutradhar/server (TS2307 @sutradhar/contracts resolution in this worktree; not touched by FR2-03)
verification.ownDoneWhen: 3 independent runs, G3/G4 independent counts reach 0 each time (main/, main-run2-old-checks/, main-run1-harness-artifacts/)
